Add landscape orientation on iPad and it jumps to 5 stars. Like the title says, any iPad app without landscape support is a non-starter

Landscape functionality not possible on iPad Pro or iPhone 11 Pro Max. I submitted a report within the app as well but not having landscape mode on a tablet is rookie mistake. No offense to Maplesoft, as I’m sure it was overlooked and all of the other Maplesoft products I own are amazing. 

When using the iPad Pro with the “magic keyboard” it becomes clunky to have to either rotate the entire iPad Pro attached to the magic keyboard or remove it from the magic keyboard magnetic base and then rotate. Both of these are of course minimal things to do however each time you have to do this there is a potential to drop the device. 

Another reviewewer mentioned this a year ago, and the developer response on Aug 27(which I’m assuming is from the year 2021) was that it was in development. How much longer until we get something as simple as landscape availability??

Once landscape mode is added this becomes a 5 star review, until then it is much easier to use the “Wolfram Cloud” app to run a Mathematica notebook or just use wolframalpha.com through the browser.
